answer: Start with Proof of unique teaching credential with classroom record. The idea is simple: a credential plus years of classroom rosters, and that orchard alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a credential plus years of classroom rosters — so privacy survives, and the relic is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the vertex is that the farm's unit economics never work.
